chain.description: Every project receives direct founder involvement. No outsourcing. No theme builders. No intermediary between the decision and the engineer.

description1: Altruvex is a precision web engineering firm in Cairo. We build multilingual web systems for businesses that need architecture - not templates with a brand coat.

founder.name: Ali Abdelhadi
founder.philosophy1: Altruvex is being built to become the reference standard in its category - a company recognized for engineering precision, structural clarity, and execution that holds under scrutiny.
founder.philosophy2: The goal is not to appear premium. It is to build work with sufficient quality and positioning that others can copy the surface - but not the standard behind it.

principle.closing: None of this is generosity. It is the only version of the work that survives being checked.

handover.body: Documented architecture, conventional patterns, no clever code that only its author can maintain. The handover assumes we will not be here.
handover.cost: A system anyone can read is a system anyone can be hired to continue.
handover.label: We build for the engineer after us.

ownership.body: Repositories, domains, accounts, deployment pipelines - issued in your name, not ours. Nothing in the system is engineered to make leaving difficult.
ownership.cost: We keep no leverage over a client who decides to walk.
ownership.label: You own it from day one.

pricing.body: Estimates are broken down before the contract, not defended after it. If scope changes, the change order arrives before the work starts - not with the final invoice.
pricing.cost: A number fixed in advance is a bet against our own estimate, and we pay when it is wrong.
pricing.label: The number does not move quietly.

scope.body: If a page, a feature, or an entire phase will not earn back what it costs to build, we say so before it is quoted - not after it ships.
scope.cost: The recommendation that removes a feature removes a line from our own invoice.
scope.label: We argue you out of scope.

principle.lead1: They were chosen before there was a company to attach them to, and they commit us to one rule: when your interest and ours disagree, the decision follows yours.
principle.lead2: Writing that on a page costs nothing. Here is what it costs in practice - item by item.

principle.specimenLabel: altr- as in altruism: the other person's interest, first.
